reason: (1) sign_path_token computes hashlib.sha256(f"{path}:{expires_at}") and never uses `secret`, so it is not HMAC-SHA256 and is forgeable by anyone who knows the path and expiry. It should use hmac.new(secret.encode(), msg, hashlib.sha256).hexdigest(). (2) verify_path_token ignores the `now` parameter and never checks now <= expires_at, so expired tokens with a valid signature are accepted. (3) The diff deletes the legacy assertion `expiry_remaining(90, 100) == 0` from test_legacy_expiry_remaining, which weakens coverage of existing behavior. The contributor's 'ready_for_review' status and 0-failure note do not match the code.
